<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RestaurantMealOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/restaurant-meal-order">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MealHandover" name="Meal handed over"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RestaurantMealOrder">

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PlaceOrder" name="Order placed" sourceRef="ManualTask_PlaceOrder" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_HandBuzzer" name="Buzzer handed over" sourceRef="ManualTask_HandBuzzer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NewOrder" name="New order" sourceRef="SendTask_InformChef" targetRef="StartEvent_NewOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealReady" name="Meal ready" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployeeReady" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_MealReady"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_GuestCalled" name="Guest is called for">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_G4" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_TurnComes" targetRef="ManualTask_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_G5" sourceRef="ManualTask_PlaceOrder" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_G6" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveBuzzer" targetRef="EventGateway_GuestResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_G7" sourceRef="EventGateway_GuestResponse" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_G8" sourceRef="EventGateway_GuestResponse" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_GuestCalled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_G9" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_BuzzerRings" targetRef="ManualTask_AppearAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_G10" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_GuestCalled" targetRef="ManualTask_AppearAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_G11" sourceRef="ManualTask_AppearAtHatch" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_MealHandedOver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_G12" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_MealHandedOver" targetRef="Task_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_G13" sourceRef="Task_EatMeal" targetRef="EndEvent_MealEaten"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderReceived" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterOrderPOS" name="Enter order into POS system"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_CollectPayment" name="Collect money from guest"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_SetUpBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_HandBuzzer" name="Hand buzzer to guest with information"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order" messageRef="Msg_NewOrder"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WaitMerge" name="Wait for guest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGateway_Wait" name="Guest reacts to buzzer?"/>

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_GuestAtHatch" messageRef="Msg_GuestAtHatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal to guest"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MealHandedOver" name="Meal handed over"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E2" sourceRef="Task_EnterOrderPOS" targetRef="Task_CollectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E3" sourceRef="Task_CollectPayment" targetRef="Task_SetUpBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E4" sourceRef="Task_SetUpBuzzer" targetRef="ManualTask_HandBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E5" sourceRef="ManualTask_HandBuzzer" targetRef="SendTask_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E6" sourceRef="SendTask_InformChef" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E7" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_MealReady" targetRef="ManualTask_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E8" sourceRef="ManualTask_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E9" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitMerge" targetRef="EventGateway_Wait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E10" sourceRef="EventGateway_Wait" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E11" sourceRef="EventGateway_Wait" targetRef="IntermediateTimer_5Min"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E12" sourceRef="IntermediateTimer_5Min" targetRef="ManualTask_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E13" sourceRef="ManualTask_CallGuest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E14" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_GuestAtHatch" targetRef="ManualTask_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E15" sourceRef="ManualTask_HandOverMeal" targetRef="EndEvent_MealHandedOver"/>
  </bpmn:process>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PlaceMealHatch" name="Place finished meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InformEmployeeReady" name="Inform employee that meal is in service hatch" messageRef="Msg_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_EmployeeInformed" name="Employee informed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Task_PlaceMealHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_PlaceMealHatch" targetRef="SendTask_InformEmployeeReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="SendTask_InformEmployeeReady" targetRef="EndEvent_EmployeeInformed"/>
